rationale: Price is sitting at 35% of today's range with the last candle showing a small bearish close, but there is no clear directional momentum — the 9-EMA and VWAP are both at $11.07, price is consolidating tightly around $11.12-$11.17 with very low volume on recent 1m bars, and the broad market is under significant stress (SPY -1.58%, VIXY +9.10%) which increases whipsaw risk. The wide spread of ~63 bps relative to the ATR makes the cost of entry unfavorable without a high-conviction setup, and no clean support/resistance break or trend continuation signal is present to justify committing capital.
